sonnet.problem: Papa Dorin comments on how he tells the passage ('I'm gonna let her words speak for themselves'). The card also says the other woman 'answers the king too', but 3:26 doesn't say whom she is speaking to. The first woman 'spoke to the king', while the other woman only 'said'.
sonnet.rule: He talks as "I" and never comments on how he tells the passage. / Leave open what the text leaves open. Who is being spoken to, why, or how two things connect.

sonnet.problem: The statement tests two claims at once (the baby must not be killed, and the woman who begged is his mother). It also re-asks the fact card 12 just answered, which is who gets the baby.
sonnet.rule: A true or false statement tests one claim. / An easy follow-up asks something new. It never re-asks the same fact.

sonnet.problem: 'I bet everybody got real QUIET real fast' guesses at the room's behavior, which the text doesn't give. A marked guess is allowed only for feelings.
sonnet.rule: A marked guess is for feelings only, never for why someone did something.
